segments.sn35.118:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
segments.sn35.118:1.2: Atha kho sakko devānamindo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho sakko devānamindo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn35.118:1.3: “ko nu kho, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme no parinibbāyanti?
segments.sn35.118:1.4: Ko pana, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāyantī”ti?
segments.sn35.118:2.1: “Santi kho, devānaminda, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.118:2.2: Tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
segments.sn35.118:2.3: Tassa taṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato tannissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ hoti tadupādānaṃ.
segments.sn35.118:2.4: Saupādāno, devānaminda, bhikkhu no parinibbāyati … pe ….
segments.sn35.118:3.1: “Santi kho, devānaminda, jivhāviññeyyā rasā … pe … santi kho, devānaminda, manoviññeyyā dhammā, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.118:3.3: Tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
segments.sn35.118:3.4: Tassa taṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato tannissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ hoti tadupādānaṃ.
segments.sn35.118:3.6: Ayaṃ kho, devānaminda, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme no parinibbāyanti.
segments.sn35.118:4.1: “Santi ca kho, devānaminda, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā, iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.118:4.2: Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
segments.sn35.118:4.3: Tassa taṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato na tannissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ hoti, na tadupādānaṃ.
segments.sn35.118:5.1: “Santi kho, devānaminda, jivhāviññeyyā rasā … pe … santi kho, devānaminda, manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.118:5.3: Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
segments.sn35.118:5.4: Tassa taṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato na tannissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ hoti na tadupādānaṃ.
segments.sn35.118:5.6: Ayaṃ kho, devānaminda, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāyantī”ti.

lines: Tadupādānanti taṃgahaṇaṃ, taṇhāgahaṇena sahagataṃ viññāṇaṃ hotīti attho.
Tattha hi attāti bhavati saññā diṭṭhi cāti attabhāvasaññā.
“Tannissitan”ti ettha taṃ -saddena heṭṭhā abhinandanādipariyāyena vuttā taṇhā paccāmaṭṭhāti āha –
